knownRisks.providerTransport: Flash-tier models have shown transport-level shake before (9 of 58 attempts in the Terminal-Bench full run); the same class can cost cells here, and no cell is retried inside the run.
knownRisks.ecrThrottle: Kept at fh_max_parallel=3, the width at which the previous two full runs had zero ECR throttles; a recurrence would be a pre-model environment failure with no attempt and no verdict.
knownRisks.specificationGaps: Two corpus tasks carry a declared specification gap (httpx-multipart-response-parsing, meriyah-explicit-resource-declarations); their verdicts are real but cannot be read as capability.
knownRisks.credentialExpiry: BENCHMARK_PROVIDER_API_KEY is the rotating dim OAuth JWT; every Generate job verifies the credential at materialization before any attempt.
knownRisks.smokeGate: No full run is dispatched until a single-task smoke has proven the candidate builds, the provider materializes under deepseek-v4-flash at max, and a task actually reaches the model phase with frozen evidence.

constraints: One predeclared headless attempt per task, all 30 Docker-eligible corpus tasks, one frozen candidate, the official agent and verifier budgets preserved (fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1) and never extended.
